notes.title: Online Multiplayer Comes to My Singing Monsters Playground!
notes.notes: [h3]Celebrate My Singing Monsters Playground’s 3rd anniversary with this free Steam Exclusive Update, bringing online multiplayer to PC Players! Face-off against your friends online and compete to be the Punch-a-Bunch champion![/h3]
